notes.title: German Localization
notes.notes:
Greetings Bakers!

We're proud to announce that the game has now been fully localized to German! A big thank you to Andrea Expósito Santana for working with us to bring German into our game!

Happy Flakin'!

notes.title: Demo version now available!
notes.notes:
Greetings potential Bakers!

We're happy to announce that Flaky Bakery now has a free demo! If you're on the fence about purchasing the game, now you can try it out for free to see what it's all about.

Demo Features:
- Play the first 5 levels and first bonus level
- Two unlockable bakers
- Two unlockable color palettes

If you don't own the game yet, please consider trying the demo! Just head over to the store page and click Download above the Add to Cart button.

Happy Flakin'!
The PhatRobit Team

notes.title: Spanish Localization

Hello Bakers!

A huge thank you goes out to the [i]Translator Team from the University of Granada[/i]:

and to [b]Juan Carlos Gil Berrozpe[/b] as the proofreader from the [i]University of Granada[/i].


Happy Flakin'!

notes.title: Leaving Early Access!
notes.notes:
Greetings Flaky Bakers!

We're very excited to announce that Flaky Bakery is leaving Early Access and entering the full release! This brings along all of our final changes to the game, including the final zone and many other additions and changes. Check out all the changes below!

[h1]New Stuff[/h1][list][*] Zone 5 is now available
[*] Six new customers to discover along with a new boss
[*] Added a bunch of new achievements
[*] Added a new splash screen
[*] Added a bunch of new color palettes
[*] Created a dedicated shop for purchasing items
[*] New trinket items are now available for purchase in the shop or earned through achievements
[*] Your cart can now be decorated with trinkets
[*] Finished adding the story cutscenes
[*] Coins are now shown floating up to your total money counter when getting an achievement to better show the monetary reward associated with them
[*] Skull trinkets can now be used as a 'skin' to the default skull when placed into the last slot on your cart decoration
[*] Every five levels now requires a certain number of Tea Bags to be purchased in the shop to unlock the level and continue your progress
[*] Added tooltips to the menu buttons on the map screen
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list][*] Reworked the bread baking minigame - you now perform key combos to bake the bread instead of moving the pan over the fires
[*] You may now perform key combos as fast as possible without any forced delays
[*] Removed special skulls - We felt these were not very fun and became obsolete once we adjusted how key combos were performed
[*] Color palettes now display a preview image
[*] Adjusted Ice Mage difficulty
[*] Updated Zone 4's map
[*] Adjusted the Necromancer's description
[*] Adjusted the Ice Mage's description
[*] Customers are now unlocked after hitting them with a skull instead of when they purchase a bread
[*] The dragon boss in Zone 2 no longer flaps his wings when facing away from the cart to remove a confusing issue
[*] Early Access rewards are no longer available for new users (because we're no longer in Early Access!)
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list][*] Fixed issues attaining achievements on steam that you have completed in-game
[*] Flown Bone customers now have two health instead of an invisible barrier and one health
[*] Fixed some color palette rewards
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
Hello bakers, here's the second of three major content updates before release! We hope you've all been enjoying the game so far! Like the first content update, this update contains more levels, bakers, achievements, palettes, customers and a new boss among other things. Check it out!

[h1]New Stuff[/h1][list][*] Zone 4 is now available with 12 new levels
[*] Added 6 Bakers
[*] Added 4 Color Palettes
[*] Added 10 Achievements 
[*] Added 5 Customers
[*] Added 1 Boss
[*] Added cutscene for Young Lad
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list][*] The Gemmed skull now deals 4 damage instead of traveling faster
[*] The Gemmed skull now costs 1,200 coins
[/list]


If you haven't already, we'd love for you to join us on our Discord server to chat it up! https://discord.gg/heQsSV5

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.notes:
Greetings bakers, here's the first of three major content updates before release! We hope you've all been enjoying the game so far! This update contains more levels, bakers, achievements, palettes, customers and a new boss among other things. Check it out!

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*] Zone 3 is now available with 12 new levels
[*] Each Zone now has its' own variation of the map music
[*] Enchanted Skulls are now available for purchase with your in-game currency from the shop (after you unlock them)
[*] Enchanted Skulls can be used by selecting them near the Play button - Only one skull can be used throughout a level
[*] Added 3 Bakers
[*] Added 2 Palettes
[*] Added 7 Achievements 
[*] Added 5 Customers
[*] Added 1 Boss
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the clock which was displaying incorrectly after defeating a boss

[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The boss fight music now escalates based on the remaining amount of customers instead of the total number of customers on screen

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.notes:
Here's our first little update after releasing into Early Access!

We plan to do weekly updates to the game every Friday and keep you all informed as to what's going on during development. Unfortunately there won't be any updates to the game for the next two Fridays, but after that we'll get back into it (next update planned for August 16th).

Here are the goods on this update:

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added two new SFX to customer Drazil
[*] Added a Theater button on the Title screen which lets users re-watch cutscenes they have previously seen before
[*] When a boss is defeated, the rate of customers will be increased
[*] Added a 'skip' button on the first cutscene
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The targeting arrow no longer vanishes after the customer it's targeting leaves the area without dying
[*] Adjusted the customer lists on Bonus 2, Level 12 and Level 17 so it's now possible to get a perfect medal on those levels
[*] Fixed an issue that broke the pause menu navigation after closing tutorial messages using the Cancel keybinding
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed customer Ogre's name to Orc Boy
[*] Made some minor adjustments to customer lists on various levels to avoid long pauses at the end of the levels
[*] Slightly increased the HP of the bosses on Level 10 and Level 20
[*] Tutorial messages are now only shown once
[/list]


If you haven't already, we'd love for you to join us on our Discord server to chat it up! We're also currently doing a Steam key giveaway on our Discord server, so if you don't own the game yet or would like to gift it to a friend for free, come subscribe for a chance to win!

Follow this link to join us: https://discord.gg/heQsSV5

notes.title: Early Access is now available!
notes.notes:
We're really excited to announce that Flaky Bakery is now in Early Access and available for purchase! Remember, if you purchase the game during Early Access you will receive some bonus content that won't be available to those that purchase the game after it leaves Early Access.

We would love to get as much feedback as we can to improve the game in the coming months as we prepare to fully release the game. If you'd like to provide your input, you can join our Discord server or head over to the Steam forums and voice your opinions. We will be much more active on Discord, but we will check the forums periodically as well.

If you'd like a chance to get a free copy of the game, join our Discord and subscribe to the list! We will be giving out keys every day for 12 days starting July 23rd to August 3rd.

We hope you all enjoy the game and look forward to chatting with you all!

Discord: https://discord.gg/heQsSV5
Forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/980190/discussions/
